item.title: Sidekick raises £7.8m Series A to scale private-bank style investing for professionals
item.description: UK wealth-tech Sidekick has raised £7.8m in Series A funding to scale investment products traditionally offered by private banks, targeting professionals with growing financial complexity. Read more: Sidekick raises £7.8m Series A to scale private-bank style investing for professionals

item.title: UK invests £36m in AI supercomputer to boost research and startup innovation
item.description: The UK Government has announced a £36m investment to expand Cambridge’s DAWN AI supercomputer, giving researchers and startups free access to advanced computing power. Read more: UK invests £36m in AI supercomputer to boost research and startup innovation

item.title: £80m student skills investment to strengthen UK defence workforce
item.description: The UK Government has announced an £80m investment to expand student places in defence-critical skills such as engineering, cyber security and advanced manufacturing. Read more: £80m student skills investment to strengthen UK defence workforce

item.title: AI voice company ElevenLabs valued at $11bn after $500m funding round
item.description: UK-based AI voice company ElevenLabs has raised $500m in new funding, tripling its valuation to $11bn as demand for human-like AI voice technology accelerates. Read more: AI voice company ElevenLabs valued at $11bn after $500m funding round

item.title: Lawhive raises $60m to scale AI-native consumer law firm across the US
item.description: UK legaltech Lawhive has raised $60m in Series B funding to expand its AI-native consumer law firm across the US, surpassing $35m in annualised revenue. Read more: Lawhive raises $60m to scale AI-native consumer law firm across the US

item.title: Cutting net migration to zero would shrink UK economy and worsen deficit, think tank warns
item.description: Cutting net migration to zero would deliver a short-term boost to living standards but ultimately prove “fiscally unsustainable”, leaving the UK economy smaller, public finances weaker and the deficit permanently higher, according to new analysis. Read more: Cutting net migration to zero would shrink UK economy and worsen deficit, think tank warns

item.title: ICO fines Imgur owner £247k over children’s data failures
item.description: The ICO has fined MediaLab £247,590 after finding Imgur failed to protect children’s personal data, allowed under-13s to use the platform without age checks and exposed them to harmful content. Read more: ICO fines Imgur owner £247k over children’s data failures

item.title: Chinese carmaker Chery to launch fourth brand in the UK
item.description: Chinese carmaker Chery is launching its fourth UK brand, Lepas, expanding its fast-growing presence as Chinese EV and hybrid brands gain ground in Britain. Read more: Chinese carmaker Chery to launch fourth brand in the UK

item.title: Hollywood money fuelled record £2.8bn spend on UK film production in 2025
item.description: Hollywood studios and streamers pushed UK film production spending to a record £2.8bn in 2025, but growth may slow as Netflix shifts projects back to the US. Read more: Hollywood money fuelled record £2.8bn spend on UK film production in 2025
